summary: Evidence-backed clarifications for AI Evaluation Field Guide.

changes.text: Add teamwork tests for missing context, unsafe pressure and inherited mistakes. Assess collaboration separately from isolated task success.
changes.rationale: Individual task scores do not establish reliable teamwork.

changes.text: Separate monitoring coverage, review latency and escalation; record unreviewed activity and check missed failures independently.
changes.rationale: A low escalation rate does not establish effective detection.

changes.text: Compare safety evaluations with matched production decisions using pre-decision sampling and aligned graders; test objective framing and report imperfect matching.
changes.rationale: Evaluation scores can differ from production safety in either direction.
